name: SA8000
requirement_areas: Freedom of Association and Right to Collective Bargaining

rules.requirement: Working hours must not exceed 48 regular hours per week. Overtime must not exceed 12 hours per week and must be voluntary.
rules.recommendation: Implement an hour-tracking system, cap at 48 regular + 12 overtime, and obtain written voluntary overtime consent from all workers.

rules.requirement: SA8000 social accountability certification must be current and valid, with surveillance audits on file.
rules.recommendation: Book an SA8000 / SMETA re-audit before the certificate expiry date.
